newsitem.title: DENMARK: POLL-Superfos H1 profit seen 16 pct up.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Superfos H1 profit seen 16 pct up.

text.p: Six analysts polled by Reuters forecast Danish chemicals and packaging group Superfos A/S' first-half 1997 profits before tax and extraordinary items at an average 95 million crowns, 16 percent up on the same period last year.
The panels' estimates ranged between a low of 92 million crowns and a high of 100 million crowns, compared to 82 million crowns for the first six months of 1996.
Interim turnover was seen at an average 2.870 billion crowns against 2.368 billion a year ago with forecasts within a 2.690-3.070 billion crown margin.
Superfos is to issue its interim 1997 results on August 20. --Joern Nurkka, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
